idea-plugin.name: Stage Other Files
idea-plugin.description:
Requires the Git staging area, which is off by default: enable it in Settings | Version Control | Git | Enable staging area.

Right-click one or more files in the staging area and choose Stage Other Files to stage every other modified tracked file. The selected files stay unstaged.

  • Selecting a folder keeps every file under it unstaged.
  • A partially staged file whose unstaged entry is selected keeps its unstaged changes.
  • Unversioned and conflicted files are never staged.
  • Files are staged in every Git repository shown in the staging area.
